The client calls it the Secret Project. 

Retrieve its roadmap, architecture and client offer before lunch ends.

Act natural. Do not download memes. This is a real rule.

1. Open a terminal.
2. Type very fast.
3. Frown at a graph.
4. Say: 'It worked locally.'

Do not make eye contact with HR.

USB capacity: 250 MB.
Target files need 200 MB.

The remaining 50 MB are not for cat videos.
Probably.

03:00 — Everyone left.
02:00 — This still feels easy.
01:00 — It no longer feels easy.
00:00 — You will learn what 'all hands' means.

Reminder: espionage is serious business.

Also reminder: delete this reminder.

EXFILTRATION UTILITY v1.0

Checks connected USB drive and transfers the Secret Project package.

Warning: once started, transfer cannot be cancelled.

The target is known internally as PROJECT NEBULA.

Collect its roadmap, architecture and client offer.
Do not assume the first expensive file is the right one.

The USB has 250 MB.
The target package needs 200 MB.

Data hoarding is not espionage.
